target.hba_membership: dbrole_readwrite with INHERIT FALSE and SET FALSE

expected_mutations: create one marker-bound disposable database and one marker-bound login role
grant the disposable login a non-inheriting, non-settable dbrole_readwrite membership so the existing Pigsty HBA group rule can authenticate it
bulk-load synthetic data in the disposable database
run a bounded write workload against the disposable database
drop only the marker-bound disposable database and role after evidence is captured
prohibited_actions: run against a production target or production data
run through an ambiguous service endpoint
change PostgreSQL, Patroni, PgBouncer, HAProxy, kernel, or Pigsty configuration
reset PostgreSQL, pg_stat_statements, operating-system, or monitoring statistics
drop operating-system caches, restart a service, checkpoint on demand, or fail over
disable durability, archive, replication, checksums, constraints, or synchronous_commit
terminate a session not created by this chapter
retain a password, connection URI, SQL text, client address, or raw monitoring payload in public evidence

purpose.question: How do dataset size and client concurrency change the throughput, latency, resource demand, WAL demand, and wait profile of one declared pg36_shop transaction mix on the recorded sandbox?
supported_claims: reproduce six cells on the recorded sandbox
compare cells within the same recorded run
estimate sandbox-only resource demand for the declared mix
bracket, but not precisely locate, a saturation knee when two concurrency levels diverge
unsupported_claims: production sizing or production SLO acceptance
HAProxy, PgBouncer, application, WAN, storage endurance, or independent failure-domain capacity
an exact saturation point from only two concurrency levels

required_properties: the target is the disposable pg36-l2-vagrant sandbox
the live node is the primary and not in recovery
the observation path is healthy enough to retain a corroborating time-series window

required_evidence_layers: pgbench client transaction log and report
Pigsty VictoriaMetrics corroboration or an explicit missing-series gap
hard_rejections: target identity, role, database, or topology differs from the contract
the database or role exists without the exact chapter marker
a non-chapter session is connected to the disposable database
any scale, concurrency level, repetition, seed, workload weight, or latency distribution is missing
a pgbench failure, skipped transaction, missing log, or statistics reset occurs
client saturation is ignored when it can explain the result
the report promotes a sandbox result to production capacity

gates.sandbox_ch26_gate: may pass after the bounded exercise and exact cleanup
production_requirements: production-representative compute, storage, network, data shape, connection path, and workload trace
open-loop offered-load sweep around the SLO boundary
maintenance, backup, replica loss, failover, and recovery capacity scenarios
at least one independently reviewed capacity forecast with lead time and business growth inputs
